description: Make one finished video longer, its take carried on with new lines written from the product page, into a new video beside it, as the app's Make this video 30 seconds does. This spends the team's credits: the price get_video lists in after_steps as make_longer, refunded if it fails. Only for a video whose after_steps offers it. Answers an id at once: call get_video with it about once a minute until its status is ready or failed.

credits.description: The credits after_steps lists for make_longer; a different figure is refused.

id.description: The id of a finished video, from make_video or list_videos.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this video. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments answers as the first call did and spends nothing more.

part.description: Which of its videos, as get_video names it: v1, the default, v2 and on.

name: make_longer
title: Make a video longer
